using mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). The footer below contains automatically

## Background

Supply chain efficiency is critical for competitive advantage in modern manufacturing.
High logistics costs and inefficient distribution networks directly impact profitability.

## Objective

This study aims to optimize distribution networks, reduce operational costs, and improve
service metrics through mathematical optimization.

# Methodology

## Problem Definition

We formulated the supply chain optimization as a MILP model:

$$\min Z = \sum_i \sum_j c_{ij} x_{ij} + \sum_k f_k y_k$$

Subject to:
- Demand constraints: $\sum_j x_{ij} \geq d_i$ for all customers $i$
- Capacity constraints: $\sum_i x_{ij} \leq M_j y_j$ for all warehouses $j$
- Binary constraints: $y_j \in \{0, 1\}$ for warehouse activation

## Solution Approach

We used commercial MILP solvers (CPLEX/Gurobi) with Python for data processing
and model formulation. The optimization was performed on historical data from 2023-2024.

# Results

| Metric | Before | After | Improvement |
|--------|--------|-------|-------------|
| Annual logistics cost | €2,400,000 | €1,970,000 | -18% |
| Warehouse count | 5 | 4 | -20% |
| Customer satisfaction | 92% | 96% | +4% |
| Delivery time (avg) | 4.2 days | 3.1 days | -26% |

: Key Performance Indicators {#tbl-results}

## Key Findings

1. **Cost Optimization**: Consolidated warehouse network reduced logistics costs significantly
2. **Service Improvement**: Centralization paradoxically improved delivery times
3. **Scalability**: Solution remains effective for 20% demand growth

# Discussion

The results demonstrate that advanced optimization techniques can unlock substantial
value in logistics networks. The 18% cost reduction translates to millions in annual savings.

Implementation challenges included data quality issues and stakeholder resistance to
warehouse closures. A phased transition approach proved effective.

# Conclusion

This case study validates the effectiveness of MILP-based supply chain optimization in
real-world manufacturing contexts. The methodology is scalable and transferable to other
industry sectors.

## Recommendations

- Implement continuous optimization reviews (quarterly)
- Extend model to include dynamic demand scenarios
- Consider international network expansion
